title: 上方保护大点停顿
description: 粉彩记录成人在大点上的小停顿，保护者专注保持下方制动手。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original soft-pastel illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult pausing comfortably on large jugs along an indoor top-rope route. Both feet stand on positive footholds, shoulders relax, and the climber looks toward the next nearby hold. Compose a wide scene containing the correctly fitted waist-and-leg-loop harness, rope tied correctly through designated tie-in points, complete upward rope to the overhead anchor, and return strand to a competent adult belayer's device. The harnessed belayer watches attentively and keeps the brake hand down on the brake strand. Use dusty mint, peach, and deep teal pigments with clear floor space. No free solo, tangled rope, captions, brands, or strained pose.
